query: select jsonb_build_object('columnExposures',(select coalesce(jsonb_agg(c.relname),'[]'::jsonb) from pg_class c join pg_namespace n on n.oid=c.relnamespace where n.nspname='public' and c.relkind in ('r','p') and c.relname ~ '^bobby_(brief|push_|coupon|usage_bonus|user_|reads$|level_uses$|admin_grant)' and (has_any_column_privilege('anon',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES') or has_any_column_privilege('authenticated',c.oid,'SELECT,INSERT,UPDATE,REFERENCES'))),'functionSchemaUsage',(select jsonb_build_object('anon',has_schema_privilege('anon','public','USAGE'),'authenticated',has_schema_privilege('authenticated','public','USAGE'),'service_role',has_schema_privilege('service_role','public','USAGE')))) as metadata;
